statement: For each of the 15 open ETP laws of EXP-C05-03 the prime powers q <= 128 admitting a linear model x*y = ax + by over GF(q) are exactly those listed in results/EXP-C05-07.json. In particular laws 670, 677, 1076, 1286 and 1313 have models of order 16 (1286 also of order 32), law 670 has a model of order 9, and no law has a linear model at an order excluded by the SAT search, the DRUP certificates (CLM-C05-08) or the ETP notes.
title: Linear models over finite fields: the orders q <= 128 at which the 15 open laws have a model x*y = ax + by over GF(q)
